profile.headline: Software Engineer at RenRe
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with nearly a decade of hands-on experience developing scalable, user-centered web applications using technologies like C#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL, and modern frameworks such as Blazor, Vue.js, and React. My journey has spanned a diverse range of industries and projects—from building enterprise-level logistics platforms to leading full-stack web development in fast-paced, Agile environments.

I take pride in writing clean, maintainable code and love collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems. Whether I’m mentoring junior developers, translating business requirements into intuitive user experiences, or working heads-down to optimize backend performance, I bring focus, adaptability, and a deep sense of ownership to every project.

Also, certified as a ScrumMaster, I’m passionate about Agile principles and continuously improving how teams work together to deliver value. My goal is to bridge the gap between technology and business—helping to shape thoughtful products that make life easier for the people who use them.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	HTML, CSS, JavaScript, DataTables JS, C#, .Net, .Net Core, Entity Framework, EF Core, Github, SQL Server, AWS, Python, Powershell
•	Developing software, automated tests, documentation, and related processes to meet and exceed stakeholder’s requirements. 
•	Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements in existing systems and platforms while working to mitigate technical debt.
•	•Improved existing code base of projects and maintained a high standard of code performance and scalability.
•	Collaborate with different teams on solutions for a variety of different business, code, and data-related problems.
•	Worked in a fast-paced professional and international environment.
•	Worked with team members to translate business requirements into detailed designs.
•	Mentored and was mentored by other team members and partners.
•	Delivered enterprise applications from design to production within tight project timelines
positions.insights: Skills: Team Development · Unit Testing · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Framework · Technical Documentation

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	HTML, CSS, JavaScript, .Net, T-SQL
•	Visual Studio 17, Visual Studio Data Tools, SSMS
•	Designing, coding, testing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting application software.
•	Participated in component and data architecture design.
•	Worked closely on an Agile team with a scrum master, business analyst, and other development team members to review and coordinate new changes including version upgrades.
•	Conducted Agile Scrum training for new employees.
•	Multitask to meet multiple deadlines efficiently and effectively.
•	Assisted team members with development, collaboration, and implementation by scheduling and presiding over meetings, organizing, and sharing documentation, and assisting with the execution of tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · JavaScript · HTML · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET Framework

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
ASP.Net, C#, LINQ, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Worked with a positive, upbeat, passionate and determined team.
Worked in a rapidly changing environment. 
Used strong interpersonal and communication skills to develop relationships throughout a diverse organization.
Worked both as a team and autonomously, identifying and solving problems. 
Used knowledge and understanding of multi-tiered architecture, web-based applications, and object-oriented design and development to develop and enhance projects.
Be involved in following a specific project through all phases of the SDLC, planning, analysis, design, implementation, testing, integration, and maintenance.
Provide back-end development with ASP.NET, C#, LINQ, and SQL.
Provide front-end development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Document thoroughly your assigned projects for both internal and customer use.
Be a source for application technical support.
Serve as a general subject matter expert for other development staff and business community members.
Assist team members in the maintenance and update of applications.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
Work with C#, .Net Core, .Net Framework, Entity Framework, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue.js, TDD, XUnit, SQL, REST APIs, GitHub, Salesforce
Work on critical projects which have revenue and/or customer deliverables attached to them
Switch gears easily and as necessary to keep up with the pace of the business
Coordinate with team leads to enable accurate planning and project timelines
Participate in the design and implement of a DevOps continuous integration environment
Participate in product architecture and solution design with other developers on the team
Communicate clearly to understand project requirements and seek clarification when necessary
Coordinate with QA team to ensure projects meet required specifications
Participate in bi-weekly sprint planning sessions

positions.title: Lead Developer, Contract
positions.description:
Developing new user-facing features using React, GraphQL, Node, Express and Apollo and python.
Building reusable components and front-end libraries for future use
Translating designs and wireframes into high quality code
Optimizing components for maximum performance across a vast array of web-capable devices and browsers
Create and manage a JavaScript based microservice infrastructure
Manage a Continuous Deployment pipeline that integrates with AWS
Interface with AWS lambda, S3, Elastic Compute, and Cloudfront to manage services, keep them online, observe metrics and stop outages before they happen.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Using SQL Server, C#, web forms, Entity Framework, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap and GitLab.
Update existing applications to ensure responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Assist in designing, configuring, building, and maintaining enterprise software applications used to support organizational needs.
Manage concurrent application development efforts through the entire software development life cycle.
Collaborate with the business partners and end users to understand needs, gather requirements, and make recommendations for application enhancements.
Evaluate application/configuration code to ensure it is structured properly, meets pre-set standards, and is compatible with approved browsers, devices, and/or operating systems.
Create and maintain documentation and source control.
Develop and maintain Guidewire application

company.name: North Carolina Joint Underwriting Association and North Carolina Insurance Underwriting Association

positions.title: Senior Programmer / Assistant Site Lead, Contract
positions.description:
Prepare database scripts for the purpose of creating new Cold Fusion, ASP .net, and/or SQL Server tables, modifying the structure of existing tables, creating indexes, constraints, triggers, etc. 
Create SQL Server stored procedures and packages.
Use Microsoft Visual Studio 2012 and Eclipse to write code using C# .Net framework, Cold Fusion, Delphi, JavaScript, Ajax, HTML, XML and CSS.
Use Redmine and Git as a repository for the source code, for checking code in and out, branching off new versions of the source code, and for tracking project work items.
Publish new versions of the application to the Development and Testing platform.
Use agile development practices - attend team meetings, planning and review meetings, and code the desired functionality, based on “user stories”, into the application.

positions.title: Computer Programmer, Contract
positions.description:
Build single page applications to replace sections of old VB code in existing application.
Using SQL Server Management Studio to track and edit stored procedures.
Resolving cross browser compatibility.
Code, test, troubleshoot programs utilizing the appropriate hardware, database, and programming technology.
Maintain and modify programs; make approved changes.
Thoroughly test and develop programming modifications.
Write new program code using specifications as provided by technical leads.
Collaborate with users and management to gain understanding of needed changes or modifications of existing programs
Prepare required documentation, including both program-level and user-level documentation
Enhance software to reduce operating time or improve efficiency
Perform software development in various programming languages and technologies: VB6, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AJAX, MS SQL Server, MS SQL Reporting Services, and Visual Studio.

positions.title: Java Developer, Contract
positions.description:
Using MVC framework, Angular JS and Require JS to update and replicate the functionality of older flash based program.
Writing RESTful web services in Java and using PostGres SQL to create custom database views and modify existing tables where necessary.
Designing and building custom Angular JS directives to make it easier for other developers to reproduce certain actions in code.
Used NetBeans IDE, with Maven repository and Tomcat web server for development.
Working as a team in an Agile SCRUM environment to design and implement features.
Manage the performance of several programs and several programming actions.
Analyze functional business applications and design specifications for functional activities. 
Develop block diagrams and logic flow charts.
Translate detailed design into computer software. 
Test, debug and refine the computer software supported to produce the required product. 
Prepare required documentation, including both program-level and user-level documentation.
Enhance software to reduce operating time or improve efficiency.
Provide technical direction to programmers to ensure program deadlines are met.

positions.title: Deli/Bakery Manager
positions.description:
Order and inventory stock, manage shrink.
Train and supervise employees.
Assist customers.
Increased profits 300% in first two months, department profits continued to rise consistently each year.
Attended food shows on behalf of the company.
Trained other department managers how to use spreadsheets for inventorying purposes (before inventory was done by hand).
Served as in-store technical support.

projects.title: Labyrinth of Crete
projects.description: Designed and developed multi-level adventure game based on the myth of the Minotaur and the Labyrinth of Crete using JavaScript and Perlenspiel.

projects.title: Budget App
projects.description:
Designed and developed application using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. Also used HTML Canvas and Google Calendar API.
Designed app to help people track their spending and when bills were due with the use of graphs and calendars.
